affected_party: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, operators, and affected stakeholders
actual_problem: A route policy can change after decisions were made, but QIF cannot yet show which historical decisions are stale, what changed, or whether revalidation restored applicability.
why_it_matters: Without versioned policy lineage, a once-valid route can retain obsolete thresholds, authority, capability, or evidence requirements and appear current.
why_now: v0.6.35 through v0.6.37 make route selection, resolution, disagreement, and adjudication executable; policy drift is now the smallest missing lifecycle link.
